title: Senior web developer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior web developer em guaíba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About the Role  We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in Word Press and Hub Spot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.  This is not a classic Word Press role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern Java Script and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.  If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,  brittle Word Press builds, you'll fit right in.  Key Responsibilities   Website Development   Design and build production-grade marketing websites in Word Press (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and Hub Spot CMS (Hub L templating, modules, themes).  Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate  prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.  Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).  Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.    API Integrations & Automation Hooks   Integrate websites with Hub Spot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.  Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.  Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).    Quality, Performance & SEO   Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.  Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, Hub Spot tracking, server-side events where needed).  Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.    Collaboration   Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.  Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/Git Hub), and documentation.  Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.    Required Skills   Technical   3+ years building production websites in Word Press (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).  Strong Hub Spot CMS experience (Hub L, modules, themes, forms, smart content).  Proficient in HTML, CSS, Java Script — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).  Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.  Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.  Comfortable in Git/Git Hub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.    Modern Web Skills   Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).  Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).  Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).  Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).    Bonus Experience   (Not required, but highly valuable) Webflow development experience.  Headless Word Press or Hub Spot setups (Next.js + WP/Hub Spot APIs).  Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.  Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.  E-commerce experience (Woo Commerce, Shopify).  Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.    Soft Skills   Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.  Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.  Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.  Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.  Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.    What Success Looks Like   In the first 60–90 days, you will:  Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.  Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).  Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (Hub Spot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.  Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

title: Senior outsystems engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior outsystems engineer em navegantes. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Senior Out Systems Engineer  About the Role   We are seeking a Senior Out Systems Engineer to lead platform stabilization and migration readiness efforts for a large-scale clinical application supporting 130+ locations nationwide. This is a highly hands-on, high-impact role focused on improving system performance, reducing risk, and preparing the platform for an eventual transition to a custom-built solution.  This engagement is expected to begin late April or early May and run approximately 6 weeks, with strong potential for extension based on performance.  What You’ll Do   Stabilize and Modernize Architecture   Assess tightly coupled module architecture and reduce dependencies  Identify and execute module extraction strategies to improve scalability  Minimize risk and blast radius of ongoing changes without disrupting workflows  Optimize Database and System Performance   Improve database performance by optimizing queries and implementing indexing strategies  Design and execute migration of binary large objects out of the database  Replace inefficient polling with event-driven or conditional patterns  Implement backpressure controls for integrations impacting system performance  Reduce Error Noise and Improve Observability   Identify and remediate recurring error patterns masking real issues  Refactor exception handling and client-side lifecycle violations  Establish a clean, monitorable baseline for system health  Build a Real Release Pipeline   Establish a true multi-environment deployment pipeline  Configure deployment automation using Out Systems APIs  Implement gated release processes with approvals and controls  Ensure non-production environments support meaningful regression testing  Manage Platform Capacity and Licensing   Audit platform usage and identify optimization opportunities  Remove unused or redundant components  Define governance for capacity-impacting changes  Extend platform headroom without impacting functionality  Prepare for Migration to Custom Platform   Document all integrations including triggers, data contracts, and failure modes  Map data entities into portable schemas  Capture business logic embedded within the platform  Identify core business logic vs platform-generated components  Advise on migration sequencing and risk across workflows  What You Bring   Required Experience   5+ years building and maintaining enterprise-scale Out Systems applications  Deep experience with Out Systems 11, Service Studio, and Lifetime API  Proven success optimizing performance including query tuning and data model improvements  Experience refactoring complex, tightly coupled systems into modular architectures  Strong SQL Server performance tuning experience including execution plans and indexing  Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation within Out Systems  Strong problem-solving skills in live production environments  Preferred Experience   Experience supporting or leading Out Systems to custom platform migrations  Background in healthcare or clinical systems with understanding of critical workflows  Familiarity with HIPAA considerations and secure data handling  Experience with license optimization and application object management  Knowledge of integration patterns across scheduling, e-signature, or CRM systems  Working Environment   Collaborate closely with internal engineering and PM leadership  Operate with high autonomy and ownership of technical decisions  Work within a live production environment supporting critical clinical operations  Balance speed and precision while minimizing risk to end users  This is a unique opportunity to step into a complex, high-visibility system, make immediate impact, and shape the foundation for a next-generation platform.

title: Full stack software engineer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Full stack software engineer em colombo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About LINES  LINES is a real-time, community-driven going-out platform — live venue videos, wait times, event listings, and exclusive deals across London, Melbourne, Sydney, and Brisbane. Tens of thousands of users rely on us every weekend.  We're scaling fast and migrating from Firebase to a fully owned AWS backend to power real-time feeds, ticketing, and what's next.   What you'll do  Design backend systems for real-time, localized, event-driven timelines (Twitter/Instagram-style) Architect feeds: fanout, ranking, filtering, personalization  Build performant APIs for mobile and web clients  Own features end-to-end — architecture, implementation, deployment, observability  Build ticketing flows: inventory, reservations, consistency, concurrency  Build ingestion pipelines (scrapers, cron, integrations) for the event database  Design data models for high-write, real-time systems  Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction  Improve infrastructure, reliability, and developer workflows  Write short specs — problem, approach, tradeoffs — to move faster, not slower     What we expect  Strong backend fundamentals, systems-first mindset  Experience with feeds, timelines, ranking, fanout, or personalization  Solid distributed systems chops: consistency, idempotency, concurrency, tradeoffs  Designs for scale even when the system is still small  Hands-on with Redis, and knows when to reach for it  Experience with SQS, SNS, Kafka, or similar  Comfortable with high-write, read-heavy workloads and eventual consistency  Pragmatic — ships impact, not over-engineering  Thrives in early-stage chaos with shifting priorities  Decides with incomplete info and iterates fast  Daily use of AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor) without compromising quality     Tech stack  Backend:  Nest JS (Node.js), Type Script   Infra:  AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, SQS, SNS, S3, Lambda), Cloudflare   Data:  Postgres (migrating), Firebase (legacy)  Frontend:  Next.js, Expo (React Native) CI/CD:  Git Hub Actions     Nice to have  Built or scaled social feeds or marketplaces  Ticketing, booking, or inventory experience  Firebase familiarity (helpful during migration) Real-time systems (chat, live updates, video) React Native or Expo   ﻿ Apply here:

title: Gerente de projetos de ti sênior
description:
Confira a vaga para Gerente de projetos de ti sênior em diadema. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Sobre a WWS  Somos uma consultoria de TI especializada em conectar profissionais de alta performance a projetos estratégicos em grandes organizações. Nosso propósito é equilibrar eficiência operacional e inovação, gerando valor real para os negócios e construindo um futuro sólido e competitivo para nossos clientes.  Sobre a vaga   Esta é uma oportunidade para atuar como Gerente de Projetos de TI em um ambiente de alta complexidade e grande escala no setor de Agronegócio.  Você será o elo entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, liderando entregas que impactam diretamente a operação de uma das maiores empresas do setor. É um papel estratégico, que exige visão sistêmica, governança e capacidade de tomada de decisão em projetos críticos.  Responsabilidades   Gestão de Portfólio: Estruturar, monitorar e reportar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e status de múltiplos projetos, garantindo aderência a cronogramas, custos e escopo.  Background Técnico: Orientar times e conduzir projetos de implementação, evolução e integração de sistemas ERP (e idealmente WMS), mapeando riscos e dependências.  Relacionamento com Negócio: Atuar como ponto focal para áreas de negócio (operações, logística, supply chain), traduzindo necessidades em entregas de TI.  Governança e Processos: Aplicar boas práticas de gerenciamento de projetos (PMBOK, Ágil ou Híbrido), gestão de mudanças e qualidade.    Requisitos   Experiência comprovada como Gerente de Projetos de TI em médias/grandes empresas.  Domínio sólido em projetos ERP (SAP, Oracle, Totvs, ou similares).  Conhecimento em WMS.  Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e tradicionais (Cascata).  Capacidade de gestão de stakeholders e fornecedores externos.    Informações Adicionais   Regime de Contratação: PJ (pessoa jurídica) Local de Trabalho: Remoto (Brasil) Viagens: Pontuais (a combinar, com custos cobertos) Setor da Cliente: Agronegócio (grande porte) Diferencial: Vivência em projetos de cadeia de suprimentos, logística ou operações agroindustriais.

title: Forensic manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Forensic manager em votorantim. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations. Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.  Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.  In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.  To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.  While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.  For more information, please see our  video

title: Senior outsystems engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior outsystems engineer em itu. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Senior Out Systems Engineer  About the Role   We are seeking a Senior Out Systems Engineer to lead platform stabilization and migration readiness efforts for a large-scale clinical application supporting 130+ locations nationwide. This is a highly hands-on, high-impact role focused on improving system performance, reducing risk, and preparing the platform for an eventual transition to a custom-built solution.  This engagement is expected to begin late April or early May and run approximately 6 weeks, with strong potential for extension based on performance.  What You’ll Do   Stabilize and Modernize Architecture   Assess tightly coupled module architecture and reduce dependencies  Identify and execute module extraction strategies to improve scalability  Minimize risk and blast radius of ongoing changes without disrupting workflows  Optimize Database and System Performance   Improve database performance by optimizing queries and implementing indexing strategies  Design and execute migration of binary large objects out of the database  Replace inefficient polling with event-driven or conditional patterns  Implement backpressure controls for integrations impacting system performance  Reduce Error Noise and Improve Observability   Identify and remediate recurring error patterns masking real issues  Refactor exception handling and client-side lifecycle violations  Establish a clean, monitorable baseline for system health  Build a Real Release Pipeline   Establish a true multi-environment deployment pipeline  Configure deployment automation using Out Systems APIs  Implement gated release processes with approvals and controls  Ensure non-production environments support meaningful regression testing  Manage Platform Capacity and Licensing   Audit platform usage and identify optimization opportunities  Remove unused or redundant components  Define governance for capacity-impacting changes  Extend platform headroom without impacting functionality  Prepare for Migration to Custom Platform   Document all integrations including triggers, data contracts, and failure modes  Map data entities into portable schemas  Capture business logic embedded within the platform  Identify core business logic vs platform-generated components  Advise on migration sequencing and risk across workflows  What You Bring   Required Experience   5+ years building and maintaining enterprise-scale Out Systems applications  Deep experience with Out Systems 11, Service Studio, and Lifetime API  Proven success optimizing performance including query tuning and data model improvements  Experience refactoring complex, tightly coupled systems into modular architectures  Strong SQL Server performance tuning experience including execution plans and indexing  Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation within Out Systems  Strong problem-solving skills in live production environments  Preferred Experience   Experience supporting or leading Out Systems to custom platform migrations  Background in healthcare or clinical systems with understanding of critical workflows  Familiarity with HIPAA considerations and secure data handling  Experience with license optimization and application object management  Knowledge of integration patterns across scheduling, e-signature, or CRM systems  Working Environment   Collaborate closely with internal engineering and PM leadership  Operate with high autonomy and ownership of technical decisions  Work within a live production environment supporting critical clinical operations  Balance speed and precision while minimizing risk to end users  This is a unique opportunity to step into a complex, high-visibility system, make immediate impact, and shape the foundation for a next-generation platform.

description:

About LINES  LINES is a real-time, community-driven going-out platform — live venue videos, wait times, event listings, and exclusive deals across London, Melbourne, Sydney, and Brisbane. title: Gerente de projetos de ti sênior
description:
Empresa está contratando Gerente de projetos de ti sênior em osasco. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Sobre a WWS  Somos uma consultoria de TI especializada em conectar profissionais de alta performance a projetos estratégicos em grandes organizações. Nosso propósito é equilibrar eficiência operacional e inovação, gerando valor real para os negócios e construindo um futuro sólido e competitivo para nossos clientes.  Sobre a vaga   Esta é uma oportunidade para atuar como Gerente de Projetos de TI em um ambiente de alta complexidade e grande escala no setor de Agronegócio.  Você será o elo entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, liderando entregas que impactam diretamente a operação de uma das maiores empresas do setor. É um papel estratégico, que exige visão sistêmica, governança e capacidade de tomada de decisão em projetos críticos.  Responsabilidades   Gestão de Portfólio: Estruturar, monitorar e reportar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e status de múltiplos projetos, garantindo aderência a cronogramas, custos e escopo.  Background Técnico: Orientar times e conduzir projetos de implementação, evolução e integração de sistemas ERP (e idealmente WMS), mapeando riscos e dependências.  Relacionamento com Negócio: Atuar como ponto focal para áreas de negócio (operações, logística, supply chain), traduzindo necessidades em entregas de TI.  Governança e Processos: Aplicar boas práticas de gerenciamento de projetos (PMBOK, Ágil ou Híbrido), gestão de mudanças e qualidade.    Requisitos   Experiência comprovada como Gerente de Projetos de TI em médias/grandes empresas.  Domínio sólido em projetos ERP (SAP, Oracle, Totvs, ou similares).  Conhecimento em WMS.  Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e tradicionais (Cascata).  Capacidade de gestão de stakeholders e fornecedores externos.    Informações Adicionais   Regime de Contratação: PJ (pessoa jurídica) Local de Trabalho: Remoto (Brasil) Viagens: Pontuais (a combinar, com custos cobertos) Setor da Cliente: Agronegócio (grande porte) Diferencial: Vivência em projetos de cadeia de suprimentos, logística ou operações agroindustriais.

title: Direct-response creative strategist
description:
Empresa está contratando Direct-response creative strategist em eldorado do sul. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About us Clickbait Agency is a You Tube ad creative and media buying agency. We only work with 8 and 9-figure DTC brands and our focus is simple, producing video creatives that scale profitably on You Tube and this means that you’ll be working directly on accounts most agencies don’t get near.  We care deeply about being the best at what we do which means fast iteration, high standards, and creatives that spend millions. We’ve built proprietary AI systems that support our creative and production workflows, and our video production runs through a dedicated team of AI prompters, so strategists can stay focused on strategy.  We think You Tube creative is going through a significant shift right now and we’re positioning ourselves at the front of it.  The role  We’re looking for a creative strategist who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script You Tube ads and mini VSLs for competitive ecommerce markets.  You’ll be responsible for research, angle development, hook writing, scripting, and iterating based on performance data. Your scripts go through our AI production team, so the output is fast and the feedback loop is short.  You’ll be working across multiple 8 and 9-figure brands simultaneously. The work is demanding and the bar is high.  What we’re looking for  We’re only looking for people who are genuinely good at this. If you’re earlier in your career or still developing your DR fundamentals, this isn’t the right fit yet.  You should have:  2+ years writing direct response video ads for You Tube or Facebook  A real understanding of Eugene Schwartz’s awareness stages and how to apply them to cold traffic  Experience scripting hooks, mini VSLs, and full ad concepts  The ability to look at performance data and use it to build the next creative  Proven spend behind your work — creatives you’ve written that have run profitably at scale  Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow    Experience in compliance-sensitive categories like supplements or weight loss is a bonus. So is familiarity with unique mechanism development and RMBC.  What we offer  Base salary with a performance bonus tied to winning creatives. When your work scales, your compensation reflects that.  You’ll have access to proprietary AI tools built specifically for our workflow, a production team that handles execution, and a team around you that takes the work seriously.  This is a fully remote position.  One thing worth knowing  There’s a short test task as part of the application process. It’s there to see how you think, not to take your time for nothing. title: Senior web developer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior web developer em santa catarina. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About the Role  We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in Word Press and Hub Spot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.  This is not a classic Word Press role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern Java Script and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.  If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,  brittle Word Press builds, you'll fit right in.  Key Responsibilities   Website Development   Design and build production-grade marketing websites in Word Press (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and Hub Spot CMS (Hub L templating, modules, themes).  Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate  prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.  Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).  Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.    API Integrations & Automation Hooks   Integrate websites with Hub Spot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.  Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.  Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).    Quality, Performance & SEO   Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.  Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, Hub Spot tracking, server-side events where needed).  Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.    Collaboration   Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.  Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/Git Hub), and documentation.  Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.    Required Skills   Technical   3+ years building production websites in Word Press (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).  Strong Hub Spot CMS experience (Hub L, modules, themes, forms, smart content).  Proficient in HTML, CSS, Java Script — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).  Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.  Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.  Comfortable in Git/Git Hub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.    Modern Web Skills   Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).  Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).  Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).  Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).    Bonus Experience   (Not required, but highly valuable) Webflow development experience.  Headless Word Press or Hub Spot setups (Next.js + WP/Hub Spot APIs).  Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.  Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.  E-commerce experience (Woo Commerce, Shopify).  Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.    Soft Skills   Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.  Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.  Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.  Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.  Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.    What Success Looks Like   In the first 60–90 days, you will:  Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.  Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).  Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (Hub Spot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.  Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

To be considered, please record a short Loom video (2 to 3 minutes) introducing yourself, describing a project or process you have owned end-to-end, and explaining why this role is the right next step for you. Applications without a Loom will not be reviewed. Send your video link and resume to  .   About Us   Life Supply USA is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce retailers of household essentials in the United States, specializing in air filters, HVAC filters, extension cords, and home goods. We operate across Amazon, Shopify, Walmart, and additional marketplaces with a lean, high-performance remote team. We are scaling fast and hiring the person who will keep the entire operation running like a machine.  The Role   We are hiring an  Operations & Project Manager  to serve as the execution backbone of the business and the primary management layer between our COO and our team.  This is  not  a coordinator role. This is a real management position with real authority.  You will own our operational rhythm, enforce accountability across every function, resolve blockers before they become problems, and ensure the entire team executes with precision, without the COO needing to be involved in day-to-day issues.  If things fall through the cracks, it is your job to catch them before anyone else notices.  Remote | Growth path to COO  What You Will Own    Click Up Environment  Own the Click Up workspace as the single source of truth for all work in progress. Enforce task hygiene daily. Audit weekly. Onboard new team members to standards.   Deadline Tracking & Escalation  Monitor all active tasks and projects for deadline risk proactively. Maintain a weekly at-risk task list. Surface imbalances to the COO with recommended reallocation before output is affected.   KPI Dashboard Management  Own the weekly KPI reporting cycle. Compile and present the consolidated dashboard to the COO weekly. Flag all missed KPIs immediately with root cause and action plan.   Operational SOP Library  Own the company's full SOP library. Every recurring operational workflow documented and current. Phase 1 is about building credibility through execution discipline and demonstrating the judgment to manage independently.  What We Offer   Competitive base salary plus performance bonuses 100% remote Paid time off Clear, defined path to COO Real management authority from day one A lean, high-performance team that values direct communication and results  Important Notes  ⚠️ No freelancers or part-time applicants Gross salary — candidate handles own taxes Full commitment required: no other clients or roles  How to Apply   We do not accept applications through Linked In.   To be considered, please record a short Loom video (2 to 3 minutes) introducing yourself, describing a project or process you have owned end-to-end, and explaining why this role is the right next step for you. Applications without a Loom will not be reviewed. Send your video link and resume to  .   We are moving quickly. Strong candidates will hear back fast.

title: Analista de dados

title: Gerente de projetos de ti sênior
description:
Confira a vaga para Gerente de projetos de ti sênior em londrina. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Sobre a WWS  Somos uma consultoria de TI especializada em conectar profissionais de alta performance a projetos estratégicos em grandes organizações. Nosso propósito é equilibrar eficiência operacional e inovação, gerando valor real para os negócios e construindo um futuro sólido e competitivo para nossos clientes.  Sobre a vaga   Esta é uma oportunidade para atuar como Gerente de Projetos de TI em um ambiente de alta complexidade e grande escala no setor de Agronegócio.  Você será o elo entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, liderando entregas que impactam diretamente a operação de uma das maiores empresas do setor. É um papel estratégico, que exige visão sistêmica, governança e capacidade de tomada de decisão em projetos críticos.  Responsabilidades   Gestão de Portfólio: Estruturar, monitorar e reportar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e status de múltiplos projetos, garantindo aderência a cronogramas, custos e escopo.  Background Técnico: Orientar times e conduzir projetos de implementação, evolução e integração de sistemas ERP (e idealmente WMS), mapeando riscos e dependências.  Relacionamento com Negócio: Atuar como ponto focal para áreas de negócio (operações, logística, supply chain), traduzindo necessidades em entregas de TI.  Governança e Processos: Aplicar boas práticas de gerenciamento de projetos (PMBOK, Ágil ou Híbrido), gestão de mudanças e qualidade.    Requisitos   Experiência comprovada como Gerente de Projetos de TI em médias/grandes empresas.  Domínio sólido em projetos ERP (SAP, Oracle, Totvs, ou similares).  Conhecimento em WMS.  Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e tradicionais (Cascata).  Capacidade de gestão de stakeholders e fornecedores externos.    Informações Adicionais   Regime de Contratação: PJ (pessoa jurídica) Local de Trabalho: Remoto (Brasil) Viagens: Pontuais (a combinar, com custos cobertos) Setor da Cliente: Agronegócio (grande porte) Diferencial: Vivência em projetos de cadeia de suprimentos, logística ou operações agroindustriais.

title: Back end developer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Back end developer em limeira. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About the Role  Staffing Abroad is seeking a  Senior Backend Engineer/ Senior Software Engineer  to join a #1 US-based Fin Tech & Crypto company  . This role is ideal for a highly skilled backend developer who excels in  C#/. NET  and has a strong focus on  writing maintainable, scalable, and secure code  . You will play a key role in shaping architecture, ensuring system performance, and embedding best practices while working in a fast-paced and innovative environment.  This is a 100% remote, full-time role  Salary $5.000 USD to $6.000 USD  English C1 required   What You Will Do    Develop and Maintain Applications  : Build, enhance, and maintain secure, scalable backend services using C#/. NET and integrate with APIs like Plaid, Dwolla, and Treasury Prime.   Shape System Architecture  : Contribute to system design, ensuring performance, scalability, and security across Fin Tech applications.   Write Quality Code  : Implement and test maintainable, well-documented code, with a focus on automation and software best practices.   Support Production Systems  : Monitor and troubleshoot production applications to ensure high availability and quick issue resolution.   Collaborate Across Teams  : Work closely with front-end, QA, product, and IT teams, while mentoring junior engineers.  Focus on Security and Compliance  : Embed security best practices and maintain compliance with Fin Tech regulations.    What You Will Need    Strong Technical Expertise  :   Solid foundation in design patterns, software development best practices, and principles like SOLID and Clean Code.  Proficiency in C#/. NET, ASP. NET MVC/Web API, and Object-Relational Mappers (ORMs).  Strong understanding of MSSQL database design and optimization.  Familiarity with asynchronous microservices architecture and distributed systems.  Experience with modern front-end and server-side technologies such as Node.js and React.  Commitment to Software Quality  :   Hands-on experience with unit testing, mocking, integration testing, and ensuring code coverage.  Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, particularly in Azure Dev Ops.  Proficient in version control systems, especially Git.  Experience and Education  :  6+ years of back-end software development experience.  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (preferred).  Collaboration and Communication  :   Excellent written and verbal communication skills.  Ability to work effectively with team members and stakeholders.  Enthusiasm for contributing to a collaborative, dynamic team environment.  Cultural Fit  :   Passion for innovation, accountability, and teamwork.  Alignment with a culture that prioritizes excellence in Fin Tech and Crypto solutions.    Plusses Include    Experience with  i Design architecture methodology  .   Familiarity with  cloud platforms  such as Azure, including their tools and services.

title: Forensic manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Forensic manager em garibaldi. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations. Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.  Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.  In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.  To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.  While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed. title: Especialista em dataops (cloud & data platform) | remoto
description:
Confira a vaga para Especialista em dataops (cloud & data platform) | remoto em carapicuíba. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

MOBI7 A Mobi7 é uma empresa que utiliza a tecnologia para criar soluções que otimizam a mobilidade, auxiliam na gestão e valorizam a segurança no trânsito. Hoje, nós fazemos parte das empresas da Localiza e temos uma plataforma de gestão de frotas corporativas, criada para monitorar e otimizar o uso de veículos leves ou pesados. E esse é só o começo  O QUE BUSCAMOS:   Buscamos um(a)  Especialista em Data Ops  para liderar a padronização e evolução da nossa plataforma de dados.  O foco principal será desenvolver  módulos Terraform reutilizáveis  , estruturando a base de infraestrutura que suporta nossos pipelines e produtos de dados.  É uma função para alguém com forte senioridade técnica, atuando na interseção entre  engenharia de dados  ,  cloud  e  automação  .  Responsabilidades e atribuições    Criar e evoluir  módulos Terraform  para padronizar componentes da plataforma de dados (redes, IAM, storage, computação, pipelines etc.);   Arquitetar, desenvolver e manter  pipelines e processos ETL/ELT  , garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e observabilidade;   Estabelecer padrões e boas práticas de  Data Ops  , incluindo versionamento, testes, deployments e monitoramento;   Dar suporte técnico e consultivo aos times de dados, ajudando a estruturar soluções robustas e alinhadas à arquitetura corporativa;  Implementar mecanismos de  governança  , segurança e otimização de custos em ambientes de dados na nuvem.    Requisitos obrigatórios    Experiência sólida com  Terraform  e infraestrutura como código;   Vivência prática em  cloud  (AWS, Azure ou GCP), especialmente em serviços de dados;   Forte conhecimento em  pipelines  ,  ETL/ELT  e arquiteturas de dados (Data Lake, DW, Lakehouse);   Proficiência em  Python  e  SQL;    Experiência com  CI/CD  aplicado a dados e automação;   Conhecimentos de containers (Docker) e, desejável, Kubernetes.    Diferenciais   Criação de bibliotecas ou módulos Terraform em escala corporativa;  Experiência com orquestradores como Airflow, Prefect, Dagster ou Step Functions;  Conhecimento de ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Cloud Watch, Grafana, Datadog);  Certificações cloud ou de engenharia de dados.    Perfil comportamental   Liderança técnica e capacidade de influenciar padrões e boas práticas;  Comunicação clara para dialogar com áreas técnicas e não técnicas;  Proatividade e visão sistêmica de plataforma.    BENEFÍ CIOS DESSA POSIÇÃ O   Participação em Lucros e Resultados;  Carro Corporativo;  Descontos em Aluguel, Assinatura e Compra de veículos;  Programa de Livre Escolha (Reembolso de Despesas Médicas);  Vale Alimentação e Refeição;  Allya;  Auxílio Home office;  Wellhub;  Plano de Saúde;  Plano Odontológico;  Seguro de Vida.

O foco principal será desenvolver  módulos Terraform reutilizáveis  , estruturando a base de infraestrutura que suporta nossos pipelines e produtos de dados.  É uma função para alguém com forte senioridade técnica, atuando na interseção entre  engenharia de dados  ,  cloud  e  automação  .  Responsabilidades e atribuições    Criar e evoluir  módulos Terraform  para padronizar componentes da plataforma de dados (redes, IAM, storage, computação, pipelines etc.);   Arquitetar, desenvolver e manter  pipelines e processos ETL/ELT  , garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e observabilidade;   Estabelecer padrões e boas práticas de  Data Ops  , incluindo versionamento, testes, deployments e monitoramento;   Dar suporte técnico e consultivo aos times de dados, ajudando a estruturar soluções robustas e alinhadas à arquitetura corporativa;  Implementar mecanismos de  governança  , segurança e otimização de custos em ambientes de dados na nuvem.    Requisitos obrigatórios    Experiência sólida com  Terraform  e infraestrutura como código;   Vivência prática em  cloud  (AWS, Azure ou GCP), especialmente em serviços de dados;   Forte conhecimento em  pipelines  ,  ETL/ELT  e arquiteturas de dados (Data Lake, DW, Lakehouse);   Proficiência em  Python  e  SQL;    Experiência com  CI/CD  aplicado a dados e automação;   Conhecimentos de containers (Docker) e, desejável, Kubernetes.    Diferenciais   Criação de bibliotecas ou módulos Terraform em escala corporativa;  Experiência com orquestradores como Airflow, Prefect, Dagster ou Step Functions;  Conhecimento de ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Cloud Watch, Grafana, Datadog);  Certificações cloud ou de engenharia de dados.    Perfil comportamental   Liderança técnica e capacidade de influenciar padrões e boas práticas;  Comunicação clara para dialogar com áreas técnicas e não técnicas;  Proatividade e visão sistêmica de plataforma. title: Analista de dados
description:
Nova oportunidade para Analista de dados em votorantim. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados que vá além de números — alguém capaz de transformar dados em insights estratégicos e apoiar decisões que impactam diretamente o crescimento do negócio. Se você tem olhar analítico, curiosidade e gosta de encontrar padrões onde outros veem apenas dados, essa oportunidade é para você.  RESPONSABILIDADES  Coletar, organizar e analisar dados de diferentes fontes  Criar dashboards e relatórios para acompanhamento de performance  Identificar padrões, tendências e oportunidades de melhoria  Apoiar equipes de marketing, produto e negócios com insights acionáveis  Monitorar KPIs e sugerir otimizações baseadas em dados  Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados garantindo qualidade e consistência  Automatizar processos e relatórios sempre que possível  REQUISITOS  Experiência prévia como Analista de Dados ou função similar  Forte habilidade analítica e raciocínio lógico  Conhecimento em ferramentas como Excel/Google Sheets, SQL e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, etc.) Noções de estatística e interpretação de dados  Capacidade de traduzir dados em insights claros e objetivos  Organização, atenção aos detalhes e proatividade  DIFERENCIAIS  Experiência com Python ou R para análise de dados  Conhecimento em Google Analytics, Big Query ou ferramentas de tracking  Experiência em ambientes de marketing ou produto  BENEFÍ CIOS  Remuneração compatível com o mercado  Bônus por desempenho (conforme política da empresa) Ambiente colaborativo, orientado a dados e inovação  Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional

title: Gerente de projetos de ti sênior
description:
Confira a vaga para Gerente de projetos de ti sênior em americana. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Sobre a WWS  Somos uma consultoria de TI especializada em conectar profissionais de alta performance a projetos estratégicos em grandes organizações. Nosso propósito é equilibrar eficiência operacional e inovação, gerando valor real para os negócios e construindo um futuro sólido e competitivo para nossos clientes.  Sobre a vaga   Esta é uma oportunidade para atuar como Gerente de Projetos de TI em um ambiente de alta complexidade e grande escala no setor de Agronegócio.  Você será o elo entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, liderando entregas que impactam diretamente a operação de uma das maiores empresas do setor. É um papel estratégico, que exige visão sistêmica, governança e capacidade de tomada de decisão em projetos críticos.  Responsabilidades   Gestão de Portfólio: Estruturar, monitorar e reportar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e status de múltiplos projetos, garantindo aderência a cronogramas, custos e escopo.  Background Técnico: Orientar times e conduzir projetos de implementação, evolução e integração de sistemas ERP (e idealmente WMS), mapeando riscos e dependências.  Relacionamento com Negócio: Atuar como ponto focal para áreas de negócio (operações, logística, supply chain), traduzindo necessidades em entregas de TI.  Governança e Processos: Aplicar boas práticas de gerenciamento de projetos (PMBOK, Ágil ou Híbrido), gestão de mudanças e qualidade.    Requisitos   Experiência comprovada como Gerente de Projetos de TI em médias/grandes empresas.  Domínio sólido em projetos ERP (SAP, Oracle, Totvs, ou similares).  Conhecimento em WMS.  Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e tradicionais (Cascata).  Capacidade de gestão de stakeholders e fornecedores externos.    Informações Adicionais   Regime de Contratação: PJ (pessoa jurídica) Local de Trabalho: Remoto (Brasil) Viagens: Pontuais (a combinar, com custos cobertos) Setor da Cliente: Agronegócio (grande porte) Diferencial: Vivência em projetos de cadeia de suprimentos, logística ou operações agroindustriais.

title: Especialista em dataops (cloud & data platform) | remoto
description:
Confira a vaga para Especialista em dataops (cloud & data platform) | remoto em valinhos. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

MOBI7 A Mobi7 é uma empresa que utiliza a tecnologia para criar soluções que otimizam a mobilidade, auxiliam na gestão e valorizam a segurança no trânsito. Hoje, nós fazemos parte das empresas da Localiza e temos uma plataforma de gestão de frotas corporativas, criada para monitorar e otimizar o uso de veículos leves ou pesados. E esse é só o começo  O QUE BUSCAMOS:   Buscamos um(a)  Especialista em Data Ops  para liderar a padronização e evolução da nossa plataforma de dados.  O foco principal será desenvolver  módulos Terraform reutilizáveis  , estruturando a base de infraestrutura que suporta nossos pipelines e produtos de dados.  É uma função para alguém com forte senioridade técnica, atuando na interseção entre  engenharia de dados  ,  cloud  e  automação  .  Responsabilidades e atribuições    Criar e evoluir  módulos Terraform  para padronizar componentes da plataforma de dados (redes, IAM, storage, computação, pipelines etc.);   Arquitetar, desenvolver e manter  pipelines e processos ETL/ELT  , garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e observabilidade;   Estabelecer padrões e boas práticas de  Data Ops  , incluindo versionamento, testes, deployments e monitoramento;   Dar suporte técnico e consultivo aos times de dados, ajudando a estruturar soluções robustas e alinhadas à arquitetura corporativa;  Implementar mecanismos de  governança  , segurança e otimização de custos em ambientes de dados na nuvem.    Requisitos obrigatórios    Experiência sólida com  Terraform  e infraestrutura como código;   Vivência prática em  cloud  (AWS, Azure ou GCP), especialmente em serviços de dados;   Forte conhecimento em  pipelines  ,  ETL/ELT  e arquiteturas de dados (Data Lake, DW, Lakehouse);   Proficiência em  Python  e  SQL;    Experiência com  CI/CD  aplicado a dados e automação;   Conhecimentos de containers (Docker) e, desejável, Kubernetes.    Diferenciais   Criação de bibliotecas ou módulos Terraform em escala corporativa;  Experiência com orquestradores como Airflow, Prefect, Dagster ou Step Functions;  Conhecimento de ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Cloud Watch, Grafana, Datadog);  Certificações cloud ou de engenharia de dados.    Perfil comportamental   Liderança técnica e capacidade de influenciar padrões e boas práticas;  Comunicação clara para dialogar com áreas técnicas e não técnicas;  Proatividade e visão sistêmica de plataforma.    BENEFÍ CIOS DESSA POSIÇÃ O   Participação em Lucros e Resultados;  Carro Corporativo;  Descontos em Aluguel, Assinatura e Compra de veículos;  Programa de Livre Escolha (Reembolso de Despesas Médicas);  Vale Alimentação e Refeição;  Allya;  Auxílio Home office;  Wellhub;  Plano de Saúde;  Plano Odontológico;  Seguro de Vida.

title: Full stack software engineer
description:

About LINES  LINES is a real-time, community-driven going-out platform — live venue videos, wait times, event listings, and exclusive deals across London, Melbourne, Sydney, and Brisbane. Tens of thousands of users rely on us every weekend.  We're scaling fast and migrating from Firebase to a fully owned AWS backend to power real-time feeds, ticketing, and what's next.   What you'll do  Design backend systems for real-time, localized, event-driven timelines (Twitter/Instagram-style) Architect feeds: fanout, ranking, filtering, personalization  Build performant APIs for mobile and web clients  Own features end-to-end — architecture, implementation, deployment, observability  Build ticketing flows: inventory, reservations, consistency, concurrency  Build ingestion pipelines (scrapers, cron, integrations) for the event database  Design data models for high-write, real-time systems  Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction  Improve infrastructure, reliability, and developer workflows  Write short specs — problem, approach, tradeoffs — to move faster, not slower     What we expect  Strong backend fundamentals, systems-first mindset  Experience with feeds, timelines, ranking, fanout, or personalization  Solid distributed systems chops: consistency, idempotency, concurrency, tradeoffs  Designs for scale even when the system is still small  Hands-on with Redis, and knows when to reach for it  Experience with SQS, SNS, Kafka, or similar  Comfortable with high-write, read-heavy workloads and eventual consistency  Pragmatic — ships impact, not over-engineering  Thrives in early-stage chaos with shifting priorities  Decides with incomplete info and iterates fast  Daily use of AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor) without compromising quality     Tech stack  Backend:  Nest JS (Node.js), Type Script   Infra:  AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, SQS, SNS, S3, Lambda), Cloudflare   Data:  Postgres (migrating), Firebase (legacy)  Frontend:  Next.js, Expo (React Native) CI/CD:  Git Hub Actions     Nice to have  Built or scaled social feeds or marketplaces  Ticketing, booking, or inventory experience  Firebase familiarity (helpful during migration) Real-time systems (chat, live updates, video) React Native or Expo   ﻿ Apply here:

title: Direct-response creative strategist
description:
Confira a vaga para Direct-response creative strategist em sumaré. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About us Clickbait Agency is a You Tube ad creative and media buying agency. We only work with 8 and 9-figure DTC brands and our focus is simple, producing video creatives that scale profitably on You Tube and this means that you’ll be working directly on accounts most agencies don’t get near.  We care deeply about being the best at what we do which means fast iteration, high standards, and creatives that spend millions. We’ve built proprietary AI systems that support our creative and production workflows, and our video production runs through a dedicated team of AI prompters, so strategists can stay focused on strategy.  We think You Tube creative is going through a significant shift right now and we’re positioning ourselves at the front of it.  The role  We’re looking for a creative strategist who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script You Tube ads and mini VSLs for competitive ecommerce markets.  You’ll be responsible for research, angle development, hook writing, scripting, and iterating based on performance data. Your scripts go through our AI production team, so the output is fast and the feedback loop is short.  You’ll be working across multiple 8 and 9-figure brands simultaneously. The work is demanding and the bar is high.  What we’re looking for  We’re only looking for people who are genuinely good at this. If you’re earlier in your career or still developing your DR fundamentals, this isn’t the right fit yet.  You should have:  2+ years writing direct response video ads for You Tube or Facebook  A real understanding of Eugene Schwartz’s awareness stages and how to apply them to cold traffic  Experience scripting hooks, mini VSLs, and full ad concepts  The ability to look at performance data and use it to build the next creative  Proven spend behind your work — creatives you’ve written that have run profitably at scale  Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow    Experience in compliance-sensitive categories like supplements or weight loss is a bonus. So is familiarity with unique mechanism development and RMBC.  What we offer  Base salary with a performance bonus tied to winning creatives. When your work scales, your compensation reflects that.  You’ll have access to proprietary AI tools built specifically for our workflow, a production team that handles execution, and a team around you that takes the work seriously.  This is a fully remote position.  One thing worth knowing  There’s a short test task as part of the application process. It’s there to see how you think, not to take your time for nothing.  Apply Here:

title: Senior web developer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior web developer em pinhais. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About the Role  We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in Word Press and Hub Spot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.  This is not a classic Word Press role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern Java Script and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.  If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,  brittle Word Press builds, you'll fit right in.  Key Responsibilities   Website Development   Design and build production-grade marketing websites in Word Press (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and Hub Spot CMS (Hub L templating, modules, themes).  Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate  prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.  Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).  Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.    API Integrations & Automation Hooks   Integrate websites with Hub Spot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.  Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.  Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).    Quality, Performance & SEO   Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.  Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, Hub Spot tracking, server-side events where needed).  Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.    Collaboration   Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.  Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/Git Hub), and documentation.  Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.    Required Skills   Technical   3+ years building production websites in Word Press (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).  Strong Hub Spot CMS experience (Hub L, modules, themes, forms, smart content).  Proficient in HTML, CSS, Java Script — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).  Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.  Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.  Comfortable in Git/Git Hub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.    Modern Web Skills   Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).  Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).  Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).  Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).    Bonus Experience   (Not required, but highly valuable) Webflow development experience.  Headless Word Press or Hub Spot setups (Next.js + WP/Hub Spot APIs).  Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.  Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.  E-commerce experience (Woo Commerce, Shopify).  Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.    Soft Skills   Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.  Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.  Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.  Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.  Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.    What Success Looks Like   In the first 60–90 days, you will:  Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.  Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).  Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (Hub Spot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.  Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

title: Senior outsystems engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior outsystems engineer em guaíba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Senior Out Systems Engineer  About the Role   We are seeking a Senior Out Systems Engineer to lead platform stabilization and migration readiness efforts for a large-scale clinical application supporting 130+ locations nationwide. This is a highly hands-on, high-impact role focused on improving system performance, reducing risk, and preparing the platform for an eventual transition to a custom-built solution.  This engagement is expected to begin late April or early May and run approximately 6 weeks, with strong potential for extension based on performance.  What You’ll Do   Stabilize and Modernize Architecture   Assess tightly coupled module architecture and reduce dependencies  Identify and execute module extraction strategies to improve scalability  Minimize risk and blast radius of ongoing changes without disrupting workflows  Optimize Database and System Performance   Improve database performance by optimizing queries and implementing indexing strategies  Design and execute migration of binary large objects out of the database  Replace inefficient polling with event-driven or conditional patterns  Implement backpressure controls for integrations impacting system performance  Reduce Error Noise and Improve Observability   Identify and remediate recurring error patterns masking real issues  Refactor exception handling and client-side lifecycle violations  Establish a clean, monitorable baseline for system health  Build a Real Release Pipeline   Establish a true multi-environment deployment pipeline  Configure deployment automation using Out Systems APIs  Implement gated release processes with approvals and controls  Ensure non-production environments support meaningful regression testing  Manage Platform Capacity and Licensing   Audit platform usage and identify optimization opportunities  Remove unused or redundant components  Define governance for capacity-impacting changes  Extend platform headroom without impacting functionality  Prepare for Migration to Custom Platform   Document all integrations including triggers, data contracts, and failure modes  Map data entities into portable schemas  Capture business logic embedded within the platform  Identify core business logic vs platform-generated components  Advise on migration sequencing and risk across workflows  What You Bring   Required Experience   5+ years building and maintaining enterprise-scale Out Systems applications  Deep experience with Out Systems 11, Service Studio, and Lifetime API  Proven success optimizing performance including query tuning and data model improvements  Experience refactoring complex, tightly coupled systems into modular architectures  Strong SQL Server performance tuning experience including execution plans and indexing  Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation within Out Systems  Strong problem-solving skills in live production environments  Preferred Experience   Experience supporting or leading Out Systems to custom platform migrations  Background in healthcare or clinical systems with understanding of critical workflows  Familiarity with HIPAA considerations and secure data handling  Experience with license optimization and application object management  Knowledge of integration patterns across scheduling, e-signature, or CRM systems  Working Environment   Collaborate closely with internal engineering and PM leadership  Operate with high autonomy and ownership of technical decisions  Work within a live production environment supporting critical clinical operations  Balance speed and precision while minimizing risk to end users  This is a unique opportunity to step into a complex, high-visibility system, make immediate impact, and shape the foundation for a next-generation platform.

About LINES  LINES is a real-time, community-driven going-out platform — live venue videos, wait times, event listings, and exclusive deals across London, Melbourne, Sydney, and Brisbane. Tens of thousands of users rely on us every weekend.  We're scaling fast and migrating from Firebase to a fully owned AWS backend to power real-time feeds, ticketing, and what's next.   What you'll do  Design backend systems for real-time, localized, event-driven timelines (Twitter/Instagram-style) Architect feeds: fanout, ranking, filtering, personalization  Build performant APIs for mobile and web clients  Own features end-to-end — architecture, implementation, deployment, observability  Build ticketing flows: inventory, reservations, consistency, concurrency  Build ingestion pipelines (scrapers, cron, integrations) for the event database  Design data models for high-write, real-time systems  Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction  Improve infrastructure, reliability, and developer workflows  Write short specs — problem, approach, tradeoffs — to move faster, not slower     What we expect  Strong backend fundamentals, systems-first mindset  Experience with feeds, timelines, ranking, fanout, or personalization  Solid distributed systems chops: consistency, idempotency, concurrency, tradeoffs  Designs for scale even when the system is still small  Hands-on with Redis, and knows when to reach for it  Experience with SQS, SNS, Kafka, or similar  Comfortable with high-write, read-heavy workloads and eventual consistency  Pragmatic — ships impact, not over-engineering  Thrives in early-stage chaos with shifting priorities  Decides with incomplete info and iterates fast  Daily use of AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor) without compromising quality     Tech stack  Backend:  Nest JS (Node.js), Type Script   Infra:  AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, SQS, SNS, S3, Lambda), Cloudflare   Data:  Postgres (migrating), Firebase (legacy)  Frontend:  Next.js, Expo (React Native) CI/CD:  Git Hub Actions     Nice to have  Built or scaled social feeds or marketplaces  Ticketing, booking, or inventory experience  Firebase familiarity (helpful during migration) Real-time systems (chat, live updates, video) React Native or Expo   ﻿ Apply here:

We operate across Amazon, Shopify, Walmart, and additional marketplaces with a lean, high-performance remote team. We are scaling fast and hiring the person who will keep the entire operation running like a machine.  The Role   We are hiring an  Operations & Project Manager  to serve as the execution backbone of the business and the primary management layer between our COO and our team.  This is  not  a coordinator role. This is a real management position with real authority.  You will own our operational rhythm, enforce accountability across every function, resolve blockers before they become problems, and ensure the entire team executes with precision, without the COO needing to be involved in day-to-day issues.  If things fall through the cracks, it is your job to catch them before anyone else notices.  Remote | Growth path to COO  What You Will Own    Click Up Environment  Own the Click Up workspace as the single source of truth for all work in progress. Enforce task hygiene daily. Audit weekly. Onboard new team members to standards.   Deadline Tracking & Escalation  Monitor all active tasks and projects for deadline risk proactively. Maintain a weekly at-risk task list. Surface root cause analysis to the COO when patterns emerge.   Meeting Cadence Ownership  Own all recurring meetings end to end: Daily Standup, Weekly 1:1s, COO Operations Review, Project Kickoffs, and Monthly Ops Review. Agendas distributed 24 hours in advance. Notes and action items distributed within 24 hours of each meeting.   Cross-Team Coordination & Blocker Resolution  Serve as the coordination layer between all functions. title: Full stack software engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Full stack software engineer em novo hamburgo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About LINES  LINES is a real-time, community-driven going-out platform — live venue videos, wait times, event listings, and exclusive deals across London, Melbourne, Sydney, and Brisbane. Tens of thousands of users rely on us every weekend.  We're scaling fast and migrating from Firebase to a fully owned AWS backend to power real-time feeds, ticketing, and what's next.   What you'll do  Design backend systems for real-time, localized, event-driven timelines (Twitter/Instagram-style) Architect feeds: fanout, ranking, filtering, personalization  Build performant APIs for mobile and web clients  Own features end-to-end — architecture, implementation, deployment, observability  Build ticketing flows: inventory, reservations, consistency, concurrency  Build ingestion pipelines (scrapers, cron, integrations) for the event database  Design data models for high-write, real-time systems  Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction  Improve infrastructure, reliability, and developer workflows  Write short specs — problem, approach, tradeoffs — to move faster, not slower     What we expect  Strong backend fundamentals, systems-first mindset  Experience with feeds, timelines, ranking, fanout, or personalization  Solid distributed systems chops: consistency, idempotency, concurrency, tradeoffs  Designs for scale even when the system is still small  Hands-on with Redis, and knows when to reach for it  Experience with SQS, SNS, Kafka, or similar  Comfortable with high-write, read-heavy workloads and eventual consistency  Pragmatic — ships impact, not over-engineering  Thrives in early-stage chaos with shifting priorities  Decides with incomplete info and iterates fast  Daily use of AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor) without compromising quality     Tech stack  Backend:  Nest JS (Node.js), Type Script   Infra:  AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, SQS, SNS, S3, Lambda), Cloudflare   Data:  Postgres (migrating), Firebase (legacy)  Frontend:  Next.js, Expo (React Native) CI/CD:  Git Hub Actions     Nice to have  Built or scaled social feeds or marketplaces  Ticketing, booking, or inventory experience  Firebase familiarity (helpful during migration) Real-time systems (chat, live updates, video) React Native or Expo   ﻿ Apply here:

Sobre a WWS  Somos uma consultoria de TI especializada em conectar profissionais de alta performance a projetos estratégicos em grandes organizações. Nosso propósito é equilibrar eficiência operacional e inovação, gerando valor real para os negócios e construindo um futuro sólido e competitivo para nossos clientes.  Sobre a vaga   Esta é uma oportunidade para atuar como Gerente de Projetos de TI em um ambiente de alta complexidade e grande escala no setor de Agronegócio.  Você será o elo entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, liderando entregas que impactam diretamente a operação de uma das maiores empresas do setor. É um papel estratégico, que exige visão sistêmica, governança e capacidade de tomada de decisão em projetos críticos.  Responsabilidades   Gestão de Portfólio: Estruturar, monitorar e reportar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e status de múltiplos projetos, garantindo aderência a cronogramas, custos e escopo.  Background Técnico: Orientar times e conduzir projetos de implementação, evolução e integração de sistemas ERP (e idealmente WMS), mapeando riscos e dependências. title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior backend engineer (golang) em mogi mirim. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.
